IIST CAMPUS · VERSION 4

Built from the map.

This version uses campus corrections supplied on 30 October 2026: named hostels, separate SAC, OAT and Multipurpose Hall, covered walks, steps, lower and upper terraces, deep ponds and sloping roads.

Tar roads have grass verges and shade trees. The central hostel area has bamboo; the roundabout has a garden and high-mast light. Heights in metres, boundary details and building outlines remain approximate. Hostel 14 is awaiting a name clarification. No building interiors are included.

Use WASD or arrow keys to walk, Shift to sprint, and the mouse to look. Click the scene to capture the mouse, or drag to look when capture is unavailable. Press V for an aerial view. On touch screens, use the arrow pad and drag the scene.

The minimap shows your position. Use “Go to a place” to travel quickly. Campus layout coverage is limited to the supplied map.
